knowledge:
- key_parameters: GTFdb=A TxDb object containing the reference transcript model ;; calGene=A character vector specifying a single gene or subset of genes to analyze (defaults to NULL for all genes) ;; Ncor=The number of threads/cores to use for multi-threaded execution via the foreach package ;; out.dir=The output directory for saving results or plots ;; CalIndex=The specific splicing event identifier (e.g., "ASS7") to calculate ratios or plot ;; Total.expdata=A matrix of transcript expression FPKM values ;; Total.snpdata=A matrix of genotype data ;; Total.snplocus=A data frame containing genomic locations of SNP markers ;; method=The statistical model used for sQTL mapping, such as "lm" (linear regression) or "glmm" (generalized linear mixed model)
- alternatives: makeTxDbFromGFF from the GenomicFeatures package is recommended to create the required TxDb object if starting from a raw GTF file ;; cufflinks is mentioned as an upstream tool to obtain the input transcript FPKM expression values
- when_to_use: Use when you have paired RNA-seq transcript expression data (FPKM) and genotype data for the same population-scale cohort and want to identify genetic variants (SNPs) associated with alternative splicing ratios (exon skipping, alternative splice sites, intron retention).
- pitfalls: Column names of the genotype matrix must exactly match the column names of the expression matrix (representing the same individuals) ;; The transcript model must be a TxDb object from the GenomicFeatures package, not a raw GTF file ;; Using too few samples may not guarantee statistically significant results; population-scale cohorts are recommended.

workflows.name: sqtl_mapping_workflow
workflows.intent: Identify genetic variants (sQTLs) affecting alternative splicing patterns from paired genotype and transcript expression data.
input: genotype_matrix.txt (Genotype data matrix with individuals as columns and SNPs as rows)
expression_matrix.txt (Transcript expression FPKM matrix with individuals as columns and transcripts as rows)
snp_locus.txt (SNP position data frame with columns SNP, CHR, and locus)
transcript_model.gtf (Reference transcript model GTF file to be converted to a TxDb object)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the required libraries and input datasets (genotype, expression, SNP positions, and TxDb object) ;; 2. Identify alternative splicing events from the transcript model using Splicingfinder ;; 3. Calculate the expression ratio of alternative splicing exons from transcript FPKM values using RatioFromFPKM ;; 4. Identify significant sQTLs associated with alternative splicing ratios using sQTLsFinder ;; 5. Visualize the sQTL results as boxplots using saveBplot
workflows.code:
library(IVAS)
data(sampleexp)
data(samplesnp)
data(samplesnplocus)
sampleDB <- system.file("extdata","sampleDB", package="IVAS")
sample.Txdb <- loadDb(sampleDB)
ASdb <- Splicingfinder(GTFdb=sample.Txdb,calGene=NULL,Ncor=1,out.dir=NULL)
ASdb <- RatioFromFPKM(GTFdb=sample.Txdb,ASdb=ASdb,Total.expdata=sampleexp,
    CalIndex="ASS7",Ncor=1,out.dir=NULL)
ASdb <- sQTLsFinder(ASdb=ASdb,Total.snpdata=samplesnp,
    Total.snplocus=samplesnplocus,method="lm",Ncor=1)
saveBplot(ASdb=ASdb,Total.snpdata=samplesnp,Total.snplocus=samplesnplocus,
    CalIndex="ASS7",out.dir="./result")
